blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Joel Villanueva on Thursday filed several resolutions commending and honoring Filipino athletes who participated in the 2026 Asian Games. In Senate Resolution No. 704, Villanueva noted the Philippine delegation’s historic achievement at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, where they earned 29 total medals — four gold, nine silver and 16 bronze — marking the country’s largest Asian Games medal haul since 1966.
